title: Prepare your tvOS apps for Dynamic Type
description: Dynamic Type empowers people to comfortably read and interact with your app by letting them choose the text size that works best for them. You’ll learn how to get your app ready for Dynamic Type on tvOS through practical techniques for implementing font scaling and adapting your layouts for larger content. You’ll also discover how to optimize your media-focused interfaces like grids and carousels, ensuring a great experience for everyone who relies on different text sizes.
